# `agents/code-quality-analyst.ts`

## Overview

This module provides utilities for analyzing code quality and review patterns. It parses structured code quality results and identifies recurring findings across code reviews, proposing new learnings when patterns exceed a defined threshold.

---

## Interfaces

### `CodeQualityResult`

Represents the structured output of a code quality analysis, containing identified patterns and their associated learning proposals.

```typescript
interface CodeQualityResult {
  patterns: {
    category: string;
    occurrences: number;
    learning: {
      scope: string;
      category: string;
      content: string;
      tags: string[];
      confidence: number;
    };
  }[];
}
```

**Members:**

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `patterns` | `array` | A list of detected patterns from code quality analysis. |
| `patterns[].category` | `string` | The category of the identified pattern. |
| `patterns[].occurrences` | `number` | The number of times this pattern was observed. |
| `patterns[].learning` | `object` | A proposed learning derived from the pattern. |
| `patterns[].learning.scope` | `string` | The scope to which the learning applies. |
| `patterns[].learning.category` | `string` | The category of the proposed learning. |
| `patterns[].learning.content` | `string` | The descriptive content of the proposed learning. |
| `patterns[].learning.tags` | `string[]` | Tags associated with the proposed learning. |
| `patterns[].learning.confidence` | `number` | A confidence score for the proposed learning. |

### `analyzeReviewPatterns`

Analyzes recent code review findings for recurring categories. If a pattern is found where the same finding category appears more than 3 times, it proposes new learnings based on those patterns.

```typescript
import { analyzeReviewPatterns } from '...'

analyzeReviewPatterns(
  taskId: string,
  findings: ReviewFinding[],
  repoFullName?: string
): Promise<void>
```

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `taskId` | `string` | ✅ | The identifier for the task associated with the review. |
| `findings` | `ReviewFinding[]` | ✅ | An array of review findings to analyze for recurring patterns. |
| `repoFullName` | `string` | ❌ | The full name of the repository (e.g., `owner/repo`). Used when proposing learnings scoped to a specific repository. |

**Returns:** `Promise<void>`

**Example:**

```typescript
import { analyzeReviewPatterns } from '...'

await analyzeReviewPatterns(
  'task-123',
  [
    { category: 'security', description: 'SQL injection risk detected' },
    { category: 'security', description: 'Unvalidated user input' },
    { category: 'security', description: 'Missing input sanitization' },
    { category: 'security', description: 'Exposed API key in source' },
  ],
  'my-org/my-repo'
)
```
